responsibility: Implements rustc’s core inference engine around `InferCtxt`: it owns snapshot-backed type, const, region, projection, and opaque-type state; provides the main APIs for relating terms through equality, subtyping, and lattice bounds; supports higher-ranked and alternate NLL-style relation checking; canonicalizes inference state for query boundaries; lowers projections, opaque types, and outlives requirements into obligations and region constraints; solves and resolves accumulated variables and lexical regions; freshens or safely exports tentative inference results; and turns inference and lifetime failures into structured diagnostics, including specialized region-error reporting and missing-type-information messages. The module’s files work together as layers: storage and undo infrastructure (`mod.rs`, `type_variable.rs`, `region_constraints`, `opaque_types/table.rs`, `undo_log.rs`), relation engines and user-facing entry points (`at.rs`, `combine.rs`, `equate.rs`, `sub.rs`, `lattice.rs`, `lub.rs`, `glb.rs`, `higher_ranked`, `nll_relate`), query/caching transport (`canonical/*`, `freshen.rs`), obligation and region processing (`projection.rs`, `free_regions.rs`, `outlives/*`, `lexical_region_resolve`), result extraction and probe escaping (`resolve.rs`, `fudge.rs`), opaque-type handling (`opaque_types.rs`), and diagnostics (`error_reporting/*`). Within this module, the subtyping relation is responsible for relating local opaque `impl Trait` values to non-opaque expected or actual types by introducing temporary generalized type variables, invoking opaque-type handling, collecting obligations, and keeping errors expressed in terms of the original related types rather than the temporary generalized variables.
